dialogues.speaker: Torchforger Statue
dialogues.text: (A towering statue that stands beneath the vast skies, watching over the land of Nod-Krai. Said to have been modeled after the Lightkeepers' founding Starshyna, Solovei the Torchforger, it has clearly endured the ravages of time.)

dialogues.speaker: Torchforger Statue
dialogues.text: (Under the statue's watchful gaze, generation after generation of Lightkeepers have upheld the time-honored oath, dedicating their blood and tears to the group's founding purpose...)

dialogues.speaker: Ratniki
dialogues.text: "We shall part the snow-curtain of the sky, and blast the winter winds across the wasteland."

dialogues.speaker: Ratniki
dialogues.text: "We are the Lightkeepers, who shine the eternal light of hope into the endless snow-swept plains."

dialogues.speaker: Torchforger Statue
dialogues.text: (Perhaps, so long as the light is not extinguished, the Lightkeepers' founding purpose will endure, until the end of the long night.)

dialogues.speaker: Torchforger Statue
dialogues.text: A statue that stands in Piramida. It appears to be highly revered by the <color=#00E1FFFF>Lightkeepers</color>.
